narrative.overview:
Coursely inherits its neutral shadcn-svelte luma foundation: a white work area, pale navigation, Inter and restrained Lucide line icons. The material is quiet and practical. Text, alignment, tonal state changes and consistent borders carry the hierarchy. This records the implemented system rather than introducing a new brand identity.

The interface has compact information rows and enough space around headings and actions to make daily work legible. Controls retain the luma library’s soft rounded shapes; data containers use smaller corners and separators. Motion belongs to control state changes and opening or closing sheets. No bespoke logo or imagery has been approved; the product name is rendered as text.
keyCharacteristics: White workspace with a pale neutral navigation surface.
Inter hierarchy, sentence-case labels and restrained Lucide line icons.
Rounded controls, bordered data containers and flat information rows.
Responsive reflow, visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Neutral State Rule
rules.body: Use the existing neutral tokens for navigation, filters and preparation states. Reserve the destructive color for invalid input; state labels must remain readable without color.

rules.name: The Single Family Rule
rules.body: Use Inter for headings, prose, labels and data. Establish hierarchy with the observed size, weight and spacing changes.

rules.name: The Reflow Rule
rules.body: When the available width narrows, stack the content and retain explicit field labels. The current module table becomes labeled rows rather than a horizontally clipped table.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Use borders and pale surface changes to separate the working content. Use the small shadow only on the desktop application inset and the substantial shadow on overlays; dimmed backdrops belong to sheets.

rules.name: The Touch Floor Rule
rules.body: Interactive buttons, navigation items, tabs and text inputs have a minimum height of 44px; informational badges remain compact. Tab tracks size naturally around those controls; clipped tables and score lists reserve space for the existing keyboard rings.

dos: Do use the existing semantic OKLCH tokens and the Inter hierarchy.
Do preserve the 44px minimum control height, keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do pair preparation and validation states with explicit text, including French field errors.
Do reflow dense data into labeled rows at narrow widths and keep sheets usable within safe areas.
Do use the installed shadcn-svelte primitives and restrained Lucide SVG icons.
Do use one gap for Fieldset groups, reserve focus clearance around table actions and scroll edges, and stack grading selectors when their context names would be truncated.
donts: Don't introduce a bespoke logo, raster artwork or marketing identity without approval.
Don't turn a status badge into an action or rely on color alone to communicate a state.
Don't replace the workspace’s flat borders with decorative card shadows.
Don't add ornamental animation or override the reduced-motion preference.
